description: Defines an enum DayOfWeekType representing days of the week with associated integer values and codes, including a method to convert integers to enum instances.

classes.name: DayOfWeekType
classes.description: Enumeration representing days of the week with utility to map integers to enum values.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the day of the week.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the day of the week.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding DayOfWeekType enum value, or INVALID if out of range.
